source.title: Tom Ford Breaks Down 20 Looks From 1981 to Now | Life in Looks | Vogue

tips.text: Statement suits in velvet, metallic or beaded fabrics are red-carpet pieces; they work only if you have the confidence and the occasion for them.
tips.why: Bold cloth demands the right setting.

tips.text: A red velvet suit can be a memorable evening look for someone who wants to stand out.
tips.why: Velvet carries rich colour well at night.
